Title: Operational Survey Timing Asynchrony Amplifies Review Dissatisfaction
Empirical_Fact: 4,976 delivered orders were surveyed prior to recorded delivery, generating 3,613 low reviews (72.6% low review rate).
Statistical_Status: Controlled Adjusted OR = 12.50x (p < 10^-50); accounts for 29.4% of delivered low reviews.
Actionable_Intervention: INT-01: Post-delivery feedback gating pilot (suppress surveys until delivery + 24h).
Priority_Tier: P0 — Immediate (Zero-Capex Software / Policy Quick Win)

Title: Non-Linear Customer Tolerance Inflection Beyond Day 3.5 Late
Empirical_Fact: Orders late >3.5 days represent 5.24% of delivered volume (5,021 orders) but generate 29.63% of delivered low reviews (3,636 low reviews).
Statistical_Status: Segmented OLS breakpoint at 0.5d; logistic steepening past 3.5d (72.4% low review rate).
Actionable_Intervention: INT-03: Proactive delay messaging + A/B tested service recovery incentive at Day 3.0 late.
Priority_Tier: P0 — Immediate (Zero-Capex Software / Policy Quick Win)

Title: SP -> RJ Linehaul Trunkline Failure Concentration
Empirical_Fact: SP -> RJ is Olist's largest interstate corridor (8,065 orders, 8.42% volume) with a 15.31% late rate and 20.15% low review rate.
Statistical_Status: Accounts for 1,625 low reviews (13.24% of platform delivered low reviews); late rate is 2.5x higher than SP -> SP.
Actionable_Intervention: INT-02: Pilot +2 business day SLA buffer recalibration and explore private 3PL linehaul routing.
Priority_Tier: P0 — Immediate (Zero-Capex Software / Policy Quick Win)

Title: Carrier Linehaul Duration Dominates Fulfillment Dissatisfaction Over Seller Handling
Empirical_Fact: Carrier linehaul accounts for 76.9% of fulfillment duration (9.3d avg) and 81.8% of Black Friday fulfillment surge (+2.7d carrier surge).
Statistical_Status: Standardized excess odds per SD is 3.2x higher for carrier transit (+120%) than merchant handling (+38%).
Business_Exposure: Interstate linehaul operations affecting 64.0% of orders.
Actionable_Intervention: INT-04 & INT-05: 3PL carrier diversification and pre-booked Black Friday linehaul capacity.

Title: Category Moderation is Statistically Negligible While Warehouse Dispatch Tail is Actionable
Empirical_Fact: Category x lateness interaction explains only 0.073% of variance, while 9.4% of orders face >5d merchant dispatch delays.
Statistical_Status: Negligible moderation proves core delay sensitivity is universal; 9.4% slow handling generates 1,992 low reviews.
Actionable_Intervention: INT-06: Graduated seller dispatch support and 48-hour SLA monitoring.
